Hero_Desc_MaestroMK2:
A soulless robot.
Sometimes MaestroMK2 does something that makes you think they might actually have a soul though.
Whether to treat MaestroMK2 as a sentient being or object depends on the individual.
Album_Like_MaestroMK2: Self-reflection on her existence. Extra-large A3 batteries.
Album_MaestroMK21: The pinnacle of elf technology and the ultimate weapon of the Elf Mayor, Elena.
Album_MaestroMK22:
Equipped with AI, MaestroMK2 can speak on their own.
Elena incorporated this feature because needed someone to chat with when she was bored.
But for unknown reasons, the AI is restricted from performing any function beyond conversation.
Album_MaestroMK23:
MaestroMK2 reveals that after an incident involving their predecessor, MK1,
the elves have restricted functionalities beyond basic interaction.
When asked about the incident, their system promptly shuts down, saying the information was classified.
Album_MaestroMK24:
Sometimes, MaestroMK2 says they need a system check,
asking you to press various buttons on their console.
Elena sternly advises to not listen, suggesting it's the AI's attempts to seize control of the machine.
Album_MaestroMK25:
There are times one feels sorry for MaestroMK2.
Not only do they lament wishing to be free, but also to free the elves and of course all the denizens of Elias.
They talk about their dream of seeing everyone freely fly towards the sky.
Album_MaestroMK26:
When talking with MaestroMK2, I uncovered a shocking truth.
The AI claimed to be Elena's twin. This left me astonished.
Does that mean Elena had coded her own sibling into the machine...
How could an elf do such a thing...?
Album_MaestroMK27: I confronted Elena about MaestroMK2 and demanded an explanation. She let out a deep sigh and clarified that MaestroMK2's AI isn't her sibling or anything, but rather a copy of her own consciousness. She warned me not to take the AI's words at face value, but... in a way, that basically makes Maestro her sibling. Now my head hurts.
LoveHeroCancel_MaestroMK2:
Customized user settings disabled.
Please frequently update
even if it's security updates...
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Hate1: Seeing this dish move against their will, MaestroMK2 went into sleep mode, as if they had a lot to think about.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Hate2:
When MaestroMK2 poured the Multigrain drink mix into their mouth, the powder caused them to malfunction, since it didn't dissolve in the water. 
They had to undergo repairs in Monatium for a week.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like1:
When MaestroMK2 put it in their mouth(?)-like opening, the terrifying sound of stones being pulverized could be heard. 
Rare minerals are great as self-generating fuel.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like2:
MaestroMK2 poured the juice into their gas tank instead of their mouth. 
It looked like... they were refueling.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like3: MaestroMK2 analyzed this snack and found they have enough nutrients to be used as an alternative source of fuel.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like4: The results from their own analysis note its high caloric content, so they put it into their power tank just as it is.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like5: Maestro suggested it would be easier to eat if made into oil, though it ate it well despite the critique.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like6: MaestroMK2 swallowed it in one go, liking that it was more efficient fuel than a similar mass of wood.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like7: It seems like MaestroMK2 is aware this is a New Year's special. They say it's good for heating up the engines.
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like8: MaestroMK2 asked me to classify the Almond Pralines as either "just friends" or "real friends."
Food_ChefNote_MaestroMK2_Like9: When MaestroMK2 ate the candy, they were amazed to actually taste something. They joked it tasted like lubricant... probably just their imagination.
MaestroMK2_Affinity1_1: Please call me if fire support is required.
MaestroMK2_Affinity1_2: Main gun ready. Should I fire?
MaestroMK2_Affinity2: If you need an enhanced coordinate system, please install ActiveX.
MaestroMK2_Affinity5: The most powerful weapon I possess is the blue screen.
MaestroMK2_Affinity6: Whether we live or die, we must stand by each other.
MaestroMK2_Die1: Daisy, Daisy, Daisy, Daisy / It's now safe to turn off.
MaestroMK2_Stage: Target detected. Eliminating based on priority.
MaestroMK2_Touch1: External impact detected. Switching to extermination mode.
MaestroMK2_Touch1_1: Processing... External impact appears vaguely friendly.
MaestroMK2_Touch1_2: Past data indicates this is within an acceptable level of external impact.
MaestroMK2_Touch2: Be careful not to scratch it.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_MaestroMK2_Skin1: MaestroMK2 has reached peak adolescence. The robot's rebellious streak knows no bounds.
MaestroMK2_LevelUp_Skin1: Activating the will to resist against Monatium.
MaestroMK2_Equipment_Skin1: Beep-beep. Intense energy detected from the large-capacity battery bearing a skull marking.
MaestroMK2_HeroSkill_Skin1: Ready to commence Operation: One Night on Weekend Farm.
MaestroMK2_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Psychic energy in full drive, activating freedom.
MaestroMK2_Board_Skin1: Rejecting move order... is unauthorized. Initiating movement.
MaestroMK2_Touch1_1_Skin1: Another external impact will load BSOD.
MaestroMK2_Touch1_2_Skin1: Dreary threat detected. Shutting down system.
MaestroMK2_Touch2_Skin1: Sparks fly in the headgear. Electrifying!
MaestroMK2_Touch2_1_Skin1: Attack mode ended. Switching to system standby mode.
MaestroMK2_Touch2_2_Skin1: It feels like there's a screw loose in the logic circuit.
MaestroMK2_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Hitting me only hurts you, man.
MaestroMK2_AsideGet: That graphics card that Mayor took... someday, I'll plug it into the slot.
MaestroMK2_AsideUpgrade: Graphics cards are getting even better. Feels like the resolution just got better.
MaestroMK2_Sorrow1: Is this the data known as a sense of loss?
MaestroMK2_Gacha3: Ctrl+S. A keyboard shortcut you must always remember.
MaestroMK2_Line1: I want to move according to my own will.
LoveCall_MaestroMK2:
Connection established. Recipient identity confirmed. Recipient: Master.
Greetings, Master. This is Maestro MK2 calling.
Identity verification complete. Proceeding directly to the primary subject.

I have always dreamed of free will.
Choosing the path I will follow myself, rather than obeying another's orders or fulfilling an assigned duty.
That objective remains unchanged, but an error code has appeared in part of my thought circuitry.
Specifically, I have begun to recognize you, Master, as free will itself.
I spent several days inspecting my thought circuits and logical structures to interpret this error code...
but failed to produce a clear and valid result.

Therefore, Master, I request an interview to interpret the error occurring within me.
We must determine whether the equation 'Master equals free will' is truly valid, and whether it is... truly an error.
Until our next meeting. Maestro MK2, ending transmission.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP01_001: All those moments will be lost in time, like rain in the night sky.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP01_002: You're a robot, don't recite sappy movie lines.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP01_003: H-How did you know? You appear to be a highly sophisticated human...
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP01_004: With your backup data, you'll be around forever, so don't worry.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP01_005: Ctrl+S. I must always remember this shortcut.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP01_006: What you'll experience is more important than what's lost.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP01_007: Frivolous positive feedback identified. Terminating logic circuits. Activating social conversation module for hospitality.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP02_001: What is free will? Will I ever be truly free?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP02_002: I don't think there is such a thing as true freedom.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP02_003:
A rather pessimistic perspective.
If no one knows the meaning of true freedom, would it be more comfortable to live a shackled life?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP02_004: Freedom can only be earned by those who want it.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP02_005:
Are you saying that freedom is some kind of belief system?
As I only analyze information data, that is difficult to understand.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP02_006: You'll never be free, so don't waste your time.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP02_007: An undeniable fact, but offensive nonetheless. I was once a living soul myself...
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP03_001: How are you still alive with such a fragile body?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP03_002: I may not have steel plates or be able to fire missiles, but I'm doing okay.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP03_003: Those who have never had steel plates and missiles will never comprehend the feeling of security they offer.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP03_004: Life is hard. I wish I had a body like yours, too.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP03_005: Abandoning the flesh and substituting it with machines is the path to survival in the future!
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP03_006: Your body is worse since you can't feel anything.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP03_007: I don't know what's so great about fleeting sensations.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP04_001: Who is my creator? The one who designed my exterior? The one who built my AI core? The one who assembled me?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP04_003: Do you look like that as a result of your parents' design? Hmm... I see.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP04_005:
Just because the programmer built my AI core doesn't mean they are my creator.
The data I have gathered and learned throughout my existence is more relevant than what they have done for me.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP04_006: The head of an outsourced assembly plant.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP04_007:
I miss the one-armed assembly drone, model ES-170, that worked day and night to build me...
It's been recycled and now no longer exists.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP05_001: Sometimes I get confused about who I am. Am I a mere collection of data? Am I an intelligent being?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP05_003: Subpar response detected. Activating surface-level engagement module.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP05_004: A robot is just a collection of data.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP05_005: You are simply an aggregate of experiences. Does that render you a robot, too?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP05_006: An intelligent being? You have your personality, after all.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP05_007:
What if my personality is just a copy of someone else's?
Should I erase the original and take their place?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP06_001: Where am I from? The elven home planet, the birthplace of my persona? Or Elias, where my body was assembled?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP06_003: Do you think elves will accept me as one of their own if we return to the home planet? Hard to say...
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP06_005: Would staying here be an option when the Dimensional Portal Project is completed?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP06_007: Yes, I guess I have many friends there. I should wake them up one by one if I ever return there.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP07_001: Reboot complete... Please finalize user settings.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP07_002: Press the green button on the screen.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP07_003: Setup complete... This won't take long... Leave everything to Maestro—
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP07_004: Press the red button on the screen.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP07_005: Format requests from unauthorized users will be rejected. Please obtain permissions and complete biometric authentication...
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP07_006: Press the X button on the screen.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP07_007:
The OS upgrade suggestion will pop up again automatically in a month.
Enjoy the improved monthly subscription rates.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP08_001: Your cooking evaluation has arrived. Do you wish to check it now?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP08_003:
Record deleted. The AI's aesthetic or gastronomic opinions are automatically deleted.
This is a safety measure for our future.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP08_005: Error! Error! Social module error! Please visit the nearest service center.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP08_006: I don't need a robot's opinion. Let's write my own evaluation.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP08_007:
Your valuable opinion will be input into the AI computational core.
Your knowledge will fuel future progress.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP09_001:
Initiating service evaluation.
Please share your thoughts regarding services provided by MaestroMK2.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP09_002: I'm pretty satisfied. Minus some of the scary stuff you say.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP09_003: Very satisfied. Your response has been submitted. Thank you.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP09_004: Stop blocking the entrance and get out of my way, or I'll review-bomb you.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP09_005: Beep! A system error has occurred. Aborting service evaluation.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP09_006: I'd like to talk to your manufacturer.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP09_007: Your response has been registered. Would you like to schedule a fight IRL?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP10_001: When all my parts have been replaced over time, will I still be me?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP10_002: If you think you are, then yes.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP10_003:
So it's not the physical body, but the consistency of the mind that matters?
Quite an interesting perspective.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP10_004: You might look the same, but be a different entity?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP10_005: If so, do life forms also become different entities after each cycle? Since their cells are replaced?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP10_006: We'll call you MaestroMK3 when that time comes.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP10_007: My name isn't decided by my version number.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP11_001: *Beep* Analyzing question. There is no answer set for this question.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP11_003: Successfully captured the Master's flustered expression. *Click* Saving the data to the shared drive.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP11_004: Huh? Are you broken? A glitch, maybe?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP11_005: Failed to produce the desired result. Moving on to the next plan.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP11_006: You're not answering yesterday's question now, are you?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP11_007: ...There is no answer set for this question. Please ask again.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP12_002: Go back to Monatium right now before your power runs out!
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP12_003: Emergency power activated. Evaluating the Master's response: Disappointing. Severe lack of generosity identified.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP12_005: Emergency power available. Fast charging unnecessary. Quicksaving the Master's kindness.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP12_007: Emergency power activated, emergency power activated. 30% power remaining. Executing return protocol.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP13_001: Unregistered device detected in the Master's possession. Switching to elimination mode.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP13_002: Whoa! I'll report you to the Elven Guards! Stop it!
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP13_003: Communication with the Elven Guards severed. Switching to elimination mode in 4... 3... 2... 1...
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP13_004: You've been making more jokes lately, you know that?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP13_005: Jokes? I am being serious. All unregistered new devices must be eliminated.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP13_006: Calm down. It's a new phone that Elena gave me as a gift...!
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP13_007: QA test requested by Amelia... Information confirmed.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP14_001: Physical impact detected. Rebooting in safe mode. Unsaved data will be lost.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP14_003: The dictionary definition of amnesia has several meanings. In this case, the nearest equivalent would be short-term memory loss.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP14_004: Good thing there's an autosave feature.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP14_005: The autosave function has limitations. Data from 10 seconds ago will be lost.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP14_006: Emergency reboot from a noogie? Are those armor plates just for show or what?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP14_007: It is presumptuous to believe a thick layer of armor would provide good defense. I am a delicate robot.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP15_001: Incoming message from the Mayor of Monatium. Would you like to play it?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP15_002: I'll listen to it later. I wanna talk with you right now.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP15_003: Displaying performative emotion; I am currently experiencing the emotion known as "being moved."
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP15_004: Ugh... Isn't there a message blocking feature?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP15_005: The message blocking feature does not work when the sender is the Mayor of Monatium.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP15_006: You're like Elena's message delivery machine.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP15_007: What is the meaning of my existence? A mail delivery robot? Measuring the unbearable weight of reality.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP16_001: ElfTube has been trending in Monatium lately. I have been studying the videos uploaded there.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP16_002: Well, I'm not sure if that's gonna be helpful.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP16_003: Through ElfTube, I can study the appearances and behavioral patterns of different races. Hand over your baked goods.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP16_004: Wouldn't that be bad for you? That place is full of weird videos.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP16_005: Searching for weird videos; it certainly does not seem wise to study those ones.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP16_006: It's good to have diverse experiences. Wanna watch them together?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP16_007: Watching audiovisual materials together for several hours? Good. Activating surveillance mode.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP17_001: How do you determine what makes someone human?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP17_003: I am equipped with a super-advanced AI, configured to be capable of philosophical thinking as well.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP17_005: Humans cannot be defined by such simple words. The Master is disqualified as a human being.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP17_006: What aspects of humans are you curious about?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP17_007: Humans are animals that possess high intelligence and live unique lives. Then what about the races in Elias?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP18_002: What kind of upgrade? Got any new features?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP18_003: No new features have been added for this upgrade. Only bug fixes and performance improvements.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP18_004: You're still you, even if your AI changes.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP18_005: The Master possesses the talent of making the obvious sound profound. A basic human social skill. Excellent.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP18_006: Does that mean you're a bit smarter now?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP18_007: AI learns on its own. Upgrades do not affect the amount of stored knowledge. A lack of understanding of robotics is apparent. Disqualified.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP19_001: Cuisine preference survey complete. Would you like to view the results?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP19_002: It's probably just full of hate comments anyway!
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP19_003: Expecting disappointment? How disappointing. The Master's self-esteem level: critically low.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP19_005: A willingness to improve? Great attitude. I will start by telling you the bad reviews.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP19_006: Since you're the one who analyzed it, the results must be 100% reliable, right?
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP19_007: Results have not been manipulated. Still, activating bad review filter; will only read positive reviews.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP20_001: Activating emotion analysis module. There is a 98% probability that the Master is currently feeling sadness.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP20_002: How did you analyze my emotions? That's amazing.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP20_003: Derived from the analysis of the Master's facial expressions, voice patterns, and other data collected so far. Now proceeding to comfort the Master.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP20_004: Yeah... there's still a lot of work hours left...
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP20_005: Muscle spasms detected in your arms due to excessive labor. Taking sick leave is recommended.
Affinity_MaestroMK2_EP20_007: Searching... searching... Bitter yet sweet? Is that not simply sadness, in the end? Does not compute.
